scenario: The ego vehicle approaches a bus that is stopped at a bus stop on a two-lane road, with the bus later merging into the ego lane ahead.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane and adjusts its behavior as the bus ahead merges into the same lane.

adversarials.behavior: The bus remains stationary at the roadside with its turn signal activated, indicating an intention to merge, then pulls out into the ego lane ahead of the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a straight two-lane road with a yellow centerline and white dashed lane markings, approaching a bus that is initially stopped on the right side of the same lane or adjacent shoulder area ahead of the ego.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain a safe following distance as the bus merges from its stopped position into the travel lane; the scenario terminates once the ego has passed the bus or adjusted to its new position in the lane.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: The ego is the green car from third-person view; the white bus is the adversarial. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial (bus). 3. Chronology: Initially, bus is stopped roadside with turn signal; midpoint, bus begins to pull out; ending, bus is fully in lane ahead of ego. 4. Evidence: Bus position shifts from right roadside to center of lane; red turn signals arrows indicate merging intent.
